steps.en: Install the client — no native library to build
steps.zh: 装客户端——没有要编译的原生库

steps.en: Iterate a topic, joining a consumer group if you want shared splits
steps.zh: 迭代一个 topic，要分摊就加入消费组

steps.en: Discovers brokers, assigns partitions, commits offsets; yields namedtuples
steps.zh: 自动发现 broker、分配分区、提交偏移，逐条交付消息

steps.en: Send messages — keyed so the same key lands on the same partition
steps.zh: 发消息——带 key，同 key 进同一分区

steps.en: Batches and retries in the background; future.get() returns once the broker confirms
steps.zh: 后台批量与重试，broker 确认后 future.get() 返回

value.en: A Kafka client that pip-installs anywhere Python runs — no librdkafka, no JVM — with Java-style consumer groups and async producing
value.zh: pip 即装的 Kafka 客户端——无 librdkafka、无 JVM，消费组与异步生产对齐 Java
